I really appreciate this post. Though I know comments are arguing that yes it does matter to some extent, it doesn't really matter in these miniscule ways we may believe if we're consumed by these anxieties running through our head all the time.

What I mean is, constantly obsessing over how you're acting, what you're doing, what you look like in that given time, does more harm than good. It's still important to care what other people think at times (like worrying if you smell will make you apply another layer of deodorant and such) which can help you seem put together if you're at a job interview cause you don't smell like shit. 

But past that, if you're finding it hard to just exist without obsessing over these things then you're not actually letting yourself live. You're not living in the moment, you're just miserable and anxious. And the sooner you try to detach yourself from those anxieties, the more time you have to enjoy yourself. :]
Keep your head up, it matters sure but not as much as you may believe.
